signature.name: VTask.inclusion
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {L : Type v} -> [CommRing R] -> [LieRing L] -> [LieAlgebra R L] -> {I₁ I₂ : LieIdeal R L} -> (h : I₁ ≤ I₂) -> ↥I₁ →ₗ⁅R⁆ ↥I₂

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total on its stated domain (pairs of Lie ideals with I₁ ≤ I₂) and always produces a well-defined, injective Lie algebra morphism. There are no junk values or special edge-case output conventions.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {L : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] {I₁ I₂ : LieIdeal R L} (h : I₁ ≤ I₂), Function.Injective (VTask.inclusion h)

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ {R : Type*} {L : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] {I₁ I₂ : LieIdeal R L} (h : I₁ ≤ I₂), Function.Surjective (VTask.inclusion h))
